purpose: Repair common training-state coverage before interpreting set loss; this is an established oracle-learning baseline, not a novelty claim
baseline_version: v6 frozen; new development pilot only
encoder: Qwen3-0.6B frozen object encoder; promote to 1.7B only after pilot

fixed.prefix_sampling: Uniform over unique prefixes of all accepted optimal plans, same flat list and sampled indices for both arms
fixed.deployment_masks: identical structural masks; no gold or optimal-continuation masks

selection.train_groups: fixed hash selection of original train groups; no test groups
selection.development: original dev plus separate train-derived rename/number/redundancy/no-op probes
selection.final_test: new frozen confirmation set after mechanism selection; existing v6 test is retrospective

budget.cpu_development_fallback: server only, 2 threads, nice 15, timeout 3600s; no GPU visibility
budget.cpu_training_admission: 100-step projection <=2400 seconds total for this two-arm run; 3600-second hard timeout
budget.calibration: time 100 updates and count encoder/label-generation costs before admission

gates.success_diagnostic: Report each seed, paired development intervals and N failure; direction must agree across seeds to call a consistent development effect
gates.stop: No model-size scaling or additional graph/CLIP arms from this diagnostic alone, even if positive; independently specified numerical interventions and strong controls required
gates.failure: Any nonfinite value, accepted action masked, data/hash mismatch or timeout stops that run without overwriting artifacts

implementation_state.graph_policy_and_full_trainer: implemented; server analytic tests and tiny four-arm smoke required before development pilot
implementation_state.graph_form: directed relation-biased graph Transformer; dense control has identical inputs, biases and parameter count
implementation_state.prefix_sampling_detail: All accepted full-plan branches; deterministic valid single continuation preserves representative targets where supported
implementation_state.language_features: frozen last-hidden-state mean pooling of public tool descriptions and predicate-type descriptions; arguments in numeric/binding channels
implemented_development_probes: identifier rename plus catalog reorder with descriptions preserved

followup_decision.trigger: Opposite effects in seeds42/43 and observed alternative-prefix coverage gap
followup_decision.change: Shared prefix distribution only; same model, optimizer, updates, labels, source train/dev and probes
followup_decision.expected: Coverage may help set loss especially on order constraints; result can be negative. Not a new-method test.
